content:
alex: quick flag, saw X-Orig-Tenant sent to fallback pool on canary. repro: POST /v1/generate X-Tenant-Id: 5555 ?force=fallback -> outbound has X-Orig-Tenant.
sophia: that's bad. sanitize_outbound_headers should prevent this.
max: canary had sanitize off for perf tests. i'll flip it and add routing scrub when pool owner != request.
infra-bot: rollback canary 0.4.7 -> fallback-test
security: tagging us. check kafka rl-proxy-logs for past occurrences and scrub if persisted.
alex: i'll open a small hotfix + e2e that asserts no tenant headers on fallback.
